introduction: Ningrum has had to face negative views from local residents since childhood because her mother, Handini, was always accused of having sex with many men. The death of one of Handini's close friends further plunges her family into local gossip. Ningrum's life becomes increasingly uneasy when the man she secretly loves, named Jalu, is trapped as Handini's new sacrifice. Ningrum has to face various supernatural terrors. Finally, Ningrum got a clue and asked for help from a Kyai who gave him a powerful spear to destroy black magic on earth.
